$ hemma rename service sso login
# setup: doctor --fix
exit: 1
--- stdout ---
--- stderr ---
Error: Service "sso" is the configured auth_service — rename refused.
Renaming it would leave the docker-compose container name and any hand-pasted
Authelia OIDC client registration pointed at the old name. Rename those by hand
first, then 'hemma defaults set auth-service login', then retry.
